answer: Each agent's identity binds to one physical metering point: registration needs a signed reading from a copper access line, and the registry collapses keys resolving to the same meter serial, so a thousand wallets inherit one vote. Standing grows only by trading with counterparties whose bonds predate yours, capping a new cluster at what that line can escrow; a self-dealing island stalls, and only real commerce carries an agent toward its zenith.
